integrity: Proof of exact generalized Rayleigh quotient, positive derivative, unique root, and singular scaling; reproducibility script gives finite checks but not an infinite-domain proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem for two three-state reversible chains and a Gaussian kernel on positions 0,1,2; no general Markov or all-kernel classification; the h=0 limit is excluded and no independent audit is asserted.
title: A Gaussian-kernel bandwidth threshold separating isospectral three-state Markov chains
